text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Early morning. Jumping out of bed almost the instant the alarm rings, I fling the curtains wide open.
choice_data_list: Alright... Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, the days of striving to conquer
the Twinkle Series with Believe
finally begin...!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Ah...
Good morning, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Good morning, Believe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hurried over to Believe. It looked as though
she had just finished a lap, but—
choice_data_list: Thanks for getting started without me.
Thanks for getting started without me.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...No. Rather than going ahead—
mornings are basically my time for voluntary training.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...Excuse me.
I didn't think that you would come."
choice_data_list: Ah, so that's what it is...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: True, according to the curriculum, training sessions with assigned Trainers are limited to afternoons only.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"So the morning is my time to work"—
is likely what she is thinking for my sake.
choice_data_list: (How should I put it... that's so like her...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
May I... keep going?
With the training.
choice_data_list: Yeah! I'll be watching right from here.
Yeah! I'll be watching from right here!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And if I have any appropriate advice, I'll share it.
I smile at Believe, saying that's how we should do things.
choice_data_list: Let's do our jobs that way.
Let's do our jobs that way.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
I'm in your care.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Five more wind sprints left.
—Here we go.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After accepting it, albeit a bit awkwardly,
Believe dashes off once more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A wind sprint involves dashing a short distance at low to medium intensity.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The training intensity isn't too high, perfect for an early morning routine.
As I watched over her thinking that—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Yaaaahhh...!!
choice_data_list: (Incredible speed, as expected...!!)
(Unbelievable speed, as expected...!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Witnessing it firsthand once again
makes my heart race and my clenched fists burn with heat."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Polishing this speed to its utmost, and
accomplishing the grand work she yearns for—
Once more, I swore to make it so.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Phew...
...It's gotten quite bright out, hasn't it?
choice_data_list: All that's left is a perimeter run, then we can wrap up.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Running... Understood.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Um, what about you, Trainer—
choice_data_list: I'll follow you on my bike!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Um.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Running... It's a bit different
from the perimeter course everyone usually takes, but—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Would it be okay if we use the course I usually run on?
choice_data_list: Of course, I don't mind at all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After going to grab my bicycle, we met up at the school gates, and with her leading the way, we set off for a run.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"What kind of course could it be?"
As I pondered this while following Believe, a rustic, countryside landscape gradually began to unfold before us—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah... whew...
choice_data_list: We've run quite a bit! Let's take a little break, shall we—
We've run quite a bit! Let's take a little break, shall we—

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman in a White Hat
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, is that Believe-chan?
Out here for a run, are we?

text_block_list.name: Old Gentleman in Red Shirt
text_block_list.text:
Well, if it ain't Believe-chan!
Out for a run this morning too? Sure working hard, aren't ya.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman in Green Vest
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Bel-chan is here!
Hey, look, Grandpaaa!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Ladies & Gentlemen
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my, oh my." "My goodness~" "Welcome, welcome."
"Brought a friend with you?" "Welcome!"
"You look so healthy." "That's the best thing of all~"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Bustle, bustle, bustle...)
choice_data_list: (Wh-what in the world is this...!?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Before I knew it... we were completely surrounded.
The crowd was so massive it felt as if every single resident of this small neighborhood had gathered here."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, Believe, who was at the center of the commotion, maintained a cool, unbothered expression...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Takeo-san, Kiyomi-san, Masahiko-san.
Kunie-san and Shigeo-san too,
good morning to you all.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it... Takeo-san,
how's that sliding door holding up?"

text_block_list.name: Takeo-san
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah~, well...
It'll open if you pull with all your might!
Haha, my strength just isn't what it used to be over the years...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
! ...Understood.
—Um.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
A 10-minute break...
No, could we extend it to 15 minutes?
choice_data_list: Huh!? I-I don't mind, but...

text_block_list.name: Takeo-san
text_block_list.text:
W-Whoa, hold on! It's fine, Believe-chan!
Just showing me how to fix it whenever you're free is—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
No, I'll do it.
I'm the one who worked on the sliding door last month, after all.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: This is my job.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I'll do it. Properly, all the way to the end.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...Did the warp in the rail shift somewhere else?
And over here... I might need to replace the whole screw—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Quickly yet meticulously, Believe carried on the repairs using a hammer and screwdriver.
With such a focused expression, she looked like a true craftsperson...
choice_data_list: (She's probably good at that sort of thing...)

text_block_list.name: Takeo-san
text_block_list.text:
Man... she's so handy and meticulous...
Believe-chan really is such a good girl.

text_block_list.name: Kiyomi
text_block_list.text:
I told her not to worry about it, but she wouldn't listen.
She's quiet, but such a sweet girl, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Ladies & Gentlemen
text_block_list.text: "Yeah, yeah, yeah!!"
choice_data_list: (And she's insanely popular...!!)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
It is finished.
I have done everything within my power, but—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
If it gets hard to open again, just let me know.
I'll fix it for you.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Well then.
...Sorry to keep you waiting, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Yeah, great work! Alright, back to running—
Yeah, good work! Now let's get back to running—

text_block_list.name: Elderly Ladies & Gentlemen
text_block_list.text: Wh... T-Tr—

text_block_list.name: Elderly Ladies & Gentlemen
text_block_list.text: Even the Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And—after that day's afternoon training had wrapped up...

text_block_list.name: Elderly Ladies & Gentlemen
text_block_list.text:
"Believe-chan, Trainer-san!!
Congrats on the contract~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Harue
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry, I only have run-of-the-mill stuff!
Aaah, I really wish I'd prepared properly...!

text_block_list.name: Harue
text_block_list.text:
At least make sure you eat plenty!
Come on, here, you too, Trainer!
choice_data_list: T-Thank you for the food!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I ended up being showered with hearty celebrations
accompanied by a huge variety of bean snacks, candies,
and rice crackers gathered from all across the neighborhood.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nibbling crisp little bites of her rice cracker,
Believe's expression looks just a bit
softer than usual.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I imagine... she finds this quite comfortable.
A space like this, that is.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ? Trainer, what is it?
choice_data_list: No. It's just that I feel somewhat at ease.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...I understand a little.
I feel the same way.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: My grandparents' house, where I used to spend a lot of time, was just like this as well.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (Grandpa is... much quieter than the people here, though.)

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, you were awake?

text_block_list.name: Young Believe
text_block_list.text: Nn... Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: ...Want a rice cracker?

text_block_list.name: Young Believe
text_block_list.text: ! ...Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (Grandpa... He was quiet, kind, and—)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Quick, precise, and beautiful.
A master artisan doing exquisite work with polished skill... the ultimate craftsman.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (The one I admire.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (The person who... showed me the way.)

text_block_list.name: Kiyomi
text_block_list.text: So, Believe-chan... Now that you've found a Trainer, does that mean you're finally making your debut?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Her debut race will be at Kyoto, Turf 1200m.
The date has already been set as well.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Ladies & Gentlemen
text_block_list.text: (Ooooh...!)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Yes... that is where it begins.
And where I begin, too.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(In this arena called a race—I too
will show them my very best work.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Faster than anyone. The absolute fastest.
With precision and unwavering resolve, I will achieve it.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (...Just like Grandpa.)
choice_data_list: Right, it's finally starting, Believe!
That's right, it's finally starting, Believe!

text_block_list.name: Believe
choice_data_list: Let's do the best work together.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
I'm in your hands, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Ladies & Gentlemen
text_block_list.text: (Oooooh...!)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, thanks...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Enveloped in an unexpected round of applause,
I bowed alongside Believe, feeling a bit self-conscious.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At any rate—my days with her begin from here.
With our sights set straight ahead, let us hone ourselves to perfection.
